name: Ikari Mio
source:
Year: 3rd Year
Beloved Goods: Coenzyme Q10
Favorite Living Thing: Kesaran Pasaran
Foods that he isn’t good with: Spicy things
Favorite Words: Fly, Pegasus!

A morbid person who seems to rise problems. Is sensitive to every sign of trouble that occurs, he imperceptibly disappears before getting involved. Regardless of the flow of before and after of his unique tempo of conversations, it is often said about him ‘I don’t know what you are thinking’. Because he is frail, he has a nutrient intake, he shows an unending commitment in his health, but is it because he’s only health conscious? It is pointed out by many people. Still, being this skinny he thinks he can eat recklessly with the stomach that he has.
